input.title: Complete T10's retrospective lifecycle record
input.body: The retrospective rework records the lifecycle T10 already lived: the charter, the frozen scope baseline, the seven A-D artefacts, the Statement of Architecture Work and delivery contract, the Phase-G compliance review, and the project's declared outputs. It changes no deliverable and no date; it names the out-of-sequence closure as the accepted exception U3-EXC-T10 and records the tranche-4 authorisation the tr4 review carries.

impact.scope: none: no deliverable changes; the record is completed
impact.schedule: none: the frozen baseline's dates stand
impact.risk: the record now supports the out-of-sequence closure (U3-EXC-T10) instead of leaving it implicit
